items.q: How much do garage cleanout services cost in Bradford?

a: Not at all — it’s one of the most common calls we get in Bradford. Garages fill up fast in a growing town, and the job’s priced and handled the same either way.

items.q: Does farm equipment in a Marsh property garage get treated as junk?
a: No. Irrigation equipment, tools and machinery get sorted with an eye for real value, and the family or executor decides what happens to them.

items.q: Do you charge extra for farm properties or long laneways?
